storyWas: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike.

scenicChapters.title: Clarence Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

storyWas: A rider’s loop: clean exit, memorable middle, calm return.

sections.advice: Use Cape Town / Western Cape edge start → Fuel stop near Sunset Beach as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Scenic stretch near Kraaifontein → High point near Stellenbosch stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Retreat → Constantia is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
